about_the_game:
The Supporter Sustainability Pack is a way for players who want to help Generation Exile continue to be developed in a sustainable and player-friendly fashion.

The Supporter Sustainability Pack includes:

  • A attire option for the player character creator

  • An additional decoration for player character's companion robot

  • Custom decorations on the main menu as clear recognition for you going the extra distance to support Generation Exile

We intend to keep providing updates to this Supporter Pack as we continue through Early Access, so as to ensure you know we haven't forgotten what anyone purchasing this upgrade has enabled us to do!

And thank you, genuinely, for your support for us and Generation Exile, no matter what form it takes.
